camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise SearchTenantTableKnowledge --region cn-hangzhou --Query '帮我找一下用户订单相关的表' --Model 'qwen-plus' --DbId 78459741 --Limit 20 --SessionId '48363552-225c-4c93-aeab-ea9b9d064b96'
description_en: Searches for tables across databases at the tenant level using natural language and returns a list of table knowledge entries
description_zh: 租户级自然语言全局找表，返回表知识列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise search-tenant-table-knowledge --query '帮我找一下用户订单相关的表' --model qwen-plus --db-id 78459741 --limit 20 --session-id 48363552-225c-4c93-aeab-ea9b9d064b96 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchTenantTableKnowledge

parameters.example: 帮我找一下用户订单相关的表
parameters.help_en: The natural language description for searching tables
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The name of the model to use. Only Qwen series models are supported
parameters.help_zh: 选用的模型名称，仅可用千问系列
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The database ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, tables are searched within the specified database. If not specified, tables are searched across all databases at the tenant level
parameters.help_zh: 数据库ID，可选。传入时在指定库内找表；不传时为租户级跨库找表
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of table knowledge entries to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回表知识条数上限，默认20，最大50
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The session ID. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: session_id
